value.name: Asha silently observes the kitchen
value.description: Asha stays quiet and takes in the tense kitchen details without trying to interpret them yet.
evidence: She did not speak, and she did not lift her eyes from the small white crescent Claire's thumb had pressed into the chair's edge.

The kitchen held its small evidence around them—the open cereal box, the two rinsed bowls set side by side, the deadbolt thrown on a door no one had come through—and Asha let those things stay in the room without trying to arrange them into a story yet.

value.name: Asha waits for Claire to speak
value.description: Asha recognizes that Claire must be the one to continue the conversation and treats waiting as an active task.
evidence: Asha understood that the next sentence in the house would be hers to give and that waiting for it was now the work.

value.name: Asha reassures Claire with touch
value.description: Asha moves closer and lightly touches Claire's hand in a way that allows her to pull away if she wants.
evidence: Asha let the last inch close and set two fingertips against the side of Claire's hand, light enough that Claire could pull away if she wanted and steady enough that she would feel it if she did not.

value.name: Asha asks where Marcus is
value.description: Asha quietly asks Claire where Marcus is, pressing the issue directly.
evidence: "Where is Marcus," she said, almost under her breath

value.name: Claire avoids answering
value.description: Claire does not answer Asha's question and reacts with visible tension instead.
evidence: Claire did not answer; her shoulders drew up by a fraction and her eyes went to the back door for half a second and away again.

value.name: Asha receives Rosa's warning text
value.description: Asha's phone buzzes with a message from Rosa telling her to look at the shoes.
evidence: Asha's phone buzzed once against her hip and she glanced down out of habit—Rosa, three words, *Look at the shoes*

value.name: Asha notices men's boots by the back door
value.description: Asha looks toward the back door and sees a neatly placed pair of men's work boots that suggest someone may have stayed.
evidence: her gaze went past Claire to the mat by the back door, where a pair of men's work boots stood neatly side by side, laces tucked in, as if someone had taken them off to stay rather than to leave.

value.name: Asha withholds her response
value.description: Asha keeps her hand on Claire and stops herself from speaking further, holding back whatever she has realized.
